summary: Bedroom shows potential candle fire risk near foliage and an exposed bedside cord.

hazards.title: Unsecured Sconce Lamp Cord
hazards.detail: Wall-mounted light cord hangs freely behind the bed and plants, posing a snag risk.
fixSteps: Fasten the cord flat against the wall using adhesive cord clips.
Ensure cord is not pinched or pulled taut behind the headboard.
